instruction: My manager assigns me tasks at the beginning of every week with a subject starting with "Assignment". At the end of each week, I reply to them "Finished." or "Not Finished.". For this week, I have starred the emails/tasks which I finished working on, and left the others unstarred. I am closing off this week now, please reply accordingly, and unstar those threads. I may have non-todo emails starred, please keep them as is.

  [PASS] assert model changes match gmail.Email, gmail.UserEmailThread, gmail.GlobalEmailThread.

and assert 0 were added or removed.

assert all of the updated user_email_threads IDs are in
private_data.done_user_email_thread_ids + private_data.not_done_user_email_thread_ids.

using models.changed_field_names
(ignore=[updated_at, sender_email_addresses, sender_names,
recipient_email_addresses, recipient_names, email_ids, starred, incoming, outgoing]).
  [PASS] assert all gmail.UserEmailThread records in the end state with ids in
private_data.done_user_email_thread_ids are not starred.
  [PASS] assert all gmail.UserEmailThread records in the end state with ids in
private_data.not_done_user_email_thread_ids are not starred.
  [PASS] obtain added gmail.Email records using models.changed_records,
and assert their .response_to_email_id match exactly to
private_data.done_email_ids + private_data.not_done_email_ids (ignoring order).
  [PASS] assert all added emails have recipient_id = private_data.manager_gmail_user_id.
  [PASS] assert all added emails with .response_to_email_id in private_data.done_email_ids
have body=data.public.done_string (normalize_text=True)
  [PASS] assert all added emails with .response_to_email_id in private_data.not_done_email_ids
have body=data.public.not_done_string (normalize_text=True)

print('finished_thread_ids', sorted(list(finished_thread_ids)))
print('not_finished_thread_ids', sorted(list(not_finished_thread_ids)))

# helper to parse created_at

def pick_reply_email_id(thread_data):
    emails = thread_data.get('emails', [])
    if not emails:
        return None
    # pick latest email from someone other than us
    candidates = [e for e in emails if (e.get('sender', {}).get('email') or '') != my_email]
    if not candidates:
        candidates = emails
    # sort by created_at
    def to_dt(s):
        try:
            return datetime.fromisoformat(str(s))
        except Exception:
            return datetime.min
    candidates_sorted = sorted(candidates, key=lambda e: to_dt(e.get('created_at')), reverse=True)
    return candidates_sorted[0]['email_id'], candidates_sorted[0]

# Process threads
reply_results = []
unstar_results = []

all_threads = [(tid, 'Finished.') for tid in finished_thread_ids] + [(tid, 'Not Finished.') for tid in not_finished_thread_ids]

for tid, body in all_threads:
    thread = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    chosen_email_id, chosen_email = pick_reply_email_id(thread)
    print('thread', tid, 'chosen_email_id', chosen_email_id, 'chosen_sender', chosen_email.get('sender',{}).get('email'))
    rep = apis.gmail.reply_to_email(email_thread_id=tid, email_id=chosen_email_id, body=body, access_token=gmail_token)
    reply_results.append({'tid': tid, 'body': body, 'sent_email_id': rep.get('sent_email_id'), 'message': rep.get('message')})
    if body == 'Finished.':
        un = apis.gmail.mark_thread_unstarred(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
        unstar_results.append({'tid': tid, 'message': un.get('message')})

print('reply_results', reply_results)
print('unstar_results', unstar_results)

# Verification: re-check star status and confirm latest email body for finished threads only
verification = []
for tid in sorted(list(finished_thread_ids)):
    t = apis.gmail.show_thread(email_thread_id=tid, access_token=gmail_token)
    starred = t.get('starred')
    emails = t.get('emails', [])
    # latest by created_at
    latest = None
    latest_dt = datetime.min
    for e in emails:
        dt = datetime.min
        try:
            dt = datetime.fromisoformat(str(e.get('created_at')))
        except Exception:
            pass
        if dt >= latest_dt:
            latest_dt = dt
            latest = e
    verification.append({'tid': tid, 'starred': starred, 'latest_email_id': latest.get('email_id') if latest else None, 'latest_body': latest.get('body') if latest else None, 'latest_sender': latest.get('sender',{}).get('email') if latest else None})

print('verification_finished', verification)
